usedFor: Basecamp is where to-dos get created, and Notion collects them as items when “New To-Do” runs “Create_Data_Source_Item”.

bestTemplate.name: “New To-Do” in Basecamp, then “Create_Data_Source_Item” in Notion
bestTemplate.why: Every Basecamp to-do shows up as a Notion item, so one database covers work from several projects.

watchOut: “New To-Do” fires when a to-do is created, so later edits in Basecamp do not update the Notion item.
